name: Kasugano Tsubone
source:
He is an educator of the superior, and is a powerful person in the shadows who manages the shogunate behind the scenes.
He sometimes goes too far in "education".
He wants to talk to you...?!

[From [url=https://ikemen.cybird.ne.jp/title/shinooku/chara/kasuganotsubone.html]official website[/url]]
